subject: Entity ownership & PO routing handshake
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: procurement@aurelia.com
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entity ownership & PO routing handshake

Hi Sara / Aurelia procurement team,

Thanks for starting vendor onboarding with Redwood. To get Aurelia set up in our vendor master and enable purchase order routing, could you please confirm the following items (quick checklist):

- Legal company name exactly as it appears on tax forms (W-9 or local equivalent).
- Any DBA / trading names you want listed on POs or invoices.
- Tax ID / VAT number (you can redacted full number; last 4 digits are fine for initial mapping).
- Remit address(es) and preferred invoice-to email for POs (e.g., accts-payable@...).
- Bank account verification or letter of authorization for ACH/wire (pdf).
- Name and email of an authorized signer for our standard supplier agreement / DocuSign.
- Any special PO routing rules (multiple remits by country, different notifications per business unit).

If you already have a vendor packet, please attach it. We typically ask for a W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) and a bank letter. Ill open the vendor record as soon as we have legal name + remit/PO email.

Timeline: if you can return items by end of day Friday (6/11), we should be able to accept POs the following week.

Cheers,

Neha Kapoor
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment stubs requested: W-9 / tax form, bank letter, proof of authorized signer]

Subject: Re: Entity ownership & PO routing handshake

Thanks Sara — thats exactly what we need, helpful. Two quick clarifications before I create the vendor record: 

1) Legal name confirmation: we will use "Aurelia Biotech, Inc." as the vendor legal name in Redwood's ERP and for 1099/withholding purposes. Please confirm that the W-9 name matches that.

2) Secondary remit / EU subsidiary: yes, we can add a second remit profile for Aurelia EU Ltd. Please provide the EU entitys legal name, VAT number, remit address and the local AP email for EUR invoicing. Our system supports per-invoice currency routing (we tag invoices by currency and country).

3) PO display name: do you want POs to show "Aurelia Labs" on the remit line for US invoices, or should it always show the legal name? If you want the DBA visible on POs, we generally set that in the vendors "display name" field.

4) DocuSign: Ill send our supplier agreement to Jonathan at the address you provided; please confirm he is authorized to sign on behalf of Aurelia Biotech, Inc.

If all good, Ill create the master record and provide the vendor code + preferred PO email mapping. Targeting to have this live by next Wednesday (6/16) if we have the EU remit details by Monday EOD.

Thanks,

Neha
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

Neha / Marcus,

Couple of internal notes before Neha finalizes the ERP record:

- Vendor legal_name must exactly match W-9 for tax reporting. If theres a parent/sub relationship we store parent_company_id; otherwise use the legal entity provided.
- For the EU remit, set vendor.multilocation = true and create a remit profile with currency=EUR, default_invoice_email = ap-emea@aurelia.eu (ask them to confirm).
- PO routing: map Redwood PO channels as follows: 
  - CHANNEL_STD_PO -> standard US POs (currency USD -> accounts-payable@aurelia.com)
  - CHANNEL_EU_PO -> EMEA POs (currency EUR -> ap-emea@aurelia.eu)
- Add notes: authorized_signer_name = Jonathan Pierce, authorized_signer_email = jonathan.pierce@aurelia.com
- Attach mapping doc for reference (vendor_field_map.xlsx).

Once Neha creates the record, send me the vendor id and Ill validate GL routing and tax buckets.

-David

David Kim
Sr. Payments Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
